verdict.rationale: First-party docs state that Bolt has a Code view showing the raw code behind a project, where developers can edit code directly. Direct edits there are free and don't use tokens. Community users also describe inspecting the generated code inside the builder. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of the editor's capabilities (file tree, multi-file editing, editor features) and independent hands-on corroboration of manual code editing in Code view.
